get.description: List all a_term panes with their sessions.

post.description:
Create a new a_term pane with sessions.

For project panes: creates shell + default agent sessions.
For adhoc panes: creates shell session only.

get.description: Get current pane count and max limit.

schema.title: Response Get Pane Count Api A Term Panes Count Get

get.description: List detached panes that can be reattached.

delete.description: Delete a pane: End its sessions in Tether, then remove the view.

get.description: Get a single a_term pane with its sessions.

put.description:
Switch the agent tool on a pane.

Finds the agent session on the pane, kills its tmux session,
updates the session mode, recreates tmux, and returns the updated pane.

post.description: Attach a detached pane back into the visible layout.
Detach a pane from the visible layout while preserving its sessions.

patch.description: Update a single pane's layout (position and size).

post.description:
Respawn the project's shell and default-agent sessions (creating missing ones).

Uses the project root from Tether's catalog and resets the tab to shell mode.

schema.title: Response Reset Project Api A Term Projects  Project Id  Reset Post

post.description: Respawn every Tether session A-Term panes show.

schema.title: Response Reset All Sessions Api A Term Reset All Post

get.description: List live sessions. Sessions shown by a detached pane are hidden unless asked for.

delete.description: End a session in Tether. Idempotent: an already-ended session reports success.

schema.title: Response Delete Session Api A Term Sessions  Session Id  Delete

patch.description: Rename a Tether session (in Tether, visible in Aico too) or reorder its view.

post.description: Respawn the session's workload: same session and tool, new generation.
Restart the agent of a session whose workload is not running.
